title: Postselection-induced localization and coherence in quantum walks on heterogeneous networks
summary: Postselection of quantum trajectories is known effectively introduce nonlinearity into dynamics of open quantum systems. We study the effect of such non-linearity in continuous-time quantum walks (CTQWs) on networks with homogeneous and heterogeneous degree distributions. Using the recently proposed nonlinear Lindblad master equation (NLME), we investigate the dynamics under two decoherence mechanisms: Haken-Strobl and quantum stochastic walk (QSW).
